responsibility: Implements LoongArch support for function-specific target pragmas and __attribute__((target(...))). It defines the accepted attribute names, parses boolean and enum forms such as strict-align, cmodel, arch, tune, lsx, and lasx, maps them through GCC’s option machinery into gcc_options, reports malformed or unknown attribute diagnostics, and builds/restores function-specific target and optimization nodes so per-function code generation uses the requested LoongArch settings.
